conversion_check.description: Shared damped least-squares IK; converged tolerance 1e-4 m and 1e-3 rad.

output_semantics: Per slot: world TCP position xyz in metres (3), first and second columns of the world TCP rotation matrix (6), native gripper scalar (1). Labels are FK of the demonstrated seven-joint command. Decoding orthonormalizes the 6D rotation and applies the shared panda_kinematics.solve_ik from the measured joints; residuals are reported.
parameter_semantics: No runtime semantic parameters; full-task ordinary Cartesian DP.
